name: Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University
description: Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University (APU) is a private university in Beppu, Oita, opened in 2000 by the Ritsumeikan Trust. About half of its students are international, and most courses are offered in both English and Japanese.
whyIncluded: APU had 10 students from Singapore enrolled in May 2023.

livingCosts.summary: APU's own sample monthly budget for a student renting in downtown Beppu: rent, utilities, food, local transport plus a yearly campus bus pass, and small extras, for 12 months a year. National Health Insurance, tuition and set-up costs are not included.
livingCosts.notes: Rung A. APU Admissions 'Money Matters' page, sample monthly living expenses for a student living in downtown Beppu (undated, read 2026-10-08; assumes tuition already paid): rent 30,000-50,000 (midpoint 40,000) + utilities 6,000 = housing 46,000; food 30,000; transport = 6,000 for 'other transportation needs' (the page says this excludes commuting) + the one-year student bus pass to campus of 60,000-100,000 (midpoint 80,000 / 12 = 6,666.67) = 12,666.67; personal = 'miscellaneous' 8,000 (National Health Insurance, approx. 20,000 per 2 semesters on APU's study-abroad accommodation page, en.apu.ac.jp/abroad/prospective/independent/accommodation/, is excluded). Excluded: the 200,000 initial cash the page says to bring for the first two months, Gakkensai student insurance (6,000/yr), academic expenses, tuition, and the AP House dormitory lump sum (approx. 400,000 per semester incl. utilities, i.e. about 66,700/month, dearer than the private-rent model used here). Bug fix 2026-10-14: health insurance taken out of the personal line, as the schema keeps insurance out of living costs.

programmes.name: College of International Management (APM), English-basis
programmes.summary: Before scholarships, 2027 entrants pay ¥1,455,000 in year 1 and ¥1,655,000 a year in years 2 to 4 (¥6,420,000 over 4 years), plus a one-off ¥200,000 admission fee. Most students get a 30-100% tuition reduction. Taught in English.
programmes.notes: Areas of study: Strategic Management and Leadership; Marketing; Accounting and Finance; Entrepreneurship and Operations Management (AACSB and AMBA accredited). 2027-entry undergraduate tuition (APU Tuition & Fees page, 0% Tuition Reduction Scholarship): year 1 ¥1,455,000 (2 semesters x ¥727,500), years 2-4 ¥1,655,000 per year, so 4-year total ¥6,420,000; recorded as the 4-year average ¥1,605,000/yr. Admission fee ¥200,000 (one-off). Tuition is semester-based: Tuition A fixed plus Tuition B that varies by semester enrolled. Comprehensive insurance (¥12,740 for first-year entrants) and AP House housing fees excluded. Most students receive a 30-100% Tuition Reduction Scholarship; the full rate is used here. laterYears added 2026-10-08 from the figures above; annualTuition is now the year-1 figure. 2024-2026 entrants (read 2026-10-13): APU's undergraduate table for students enrolled AY 2020 - AY 2026 (student-site PDF 'Students enrolled since AY 2020'; Undergraduate Application Handbook for 2026 enrollment) charges JPY 650,000 a semester in year 1 and JPY 750,000 a semester in years 2-4, admission fee JPY 200,000, so each history row carries its own laterYears (JPY 1,500,000 from year 2). APU fixes tuition by entering cohort, so cohortLocked is true.

programmes.name: Graduate School of Management, MBA
programmes.summary: Before scholarships, 2027 entrants pay ¥2,000,000 in year 1 and ¥2,200,000 in year 2 (¥4,200,000 for the 2-year MBA), plus a one-off ¥200,000 admission fee. Taught in English.
programmes.notes: Graduate Tuition and Fees page (from AY2027): MBA total tuition ¥4,200,000 for completion, divided by a 2-year standard duration = ¥2,100,000/yr. Admission fee ¥200,000. Insurance ¥6,850 excluded. Tuition may change and varies with the APU Tuition Reduction Scholarship. Fully English-based. History rows (read 2026-10-13): APU 'Tuition fees (Graduate School)' page, table for students enrolled in AY 2020 - AY 2026: 2-year standard course semesters ¥900,000, ¥900,000, ¥1,000,000, ¥1,000,000, total ¥3,800,000, divided by 2 years = ¥1,900,000/yr; admission fee ¥200,000. Second look 2026-10-14: the summary quoted a fixed programme total but cohortLocked was false, so the site grew year 2 by the yearly increase. APU's graduate fee page (https://en.apu.ac.jp/home/life/content32/, read 2026-10-14) publishes one semester-by-semester schedule per entering cohort ('Students enrolled in AY2027': MBA semesters 1-2 ¥1,000,000 each and 3-4 ¥1,100,000 each, total ¥4,200,000; 'Students enrolled in AY2020 and AY2026 earlier': ¥900,000 x 2 then ¥1,000,000 x 2, total ¥3,800,000), so cohortLocked is now true as for the undergraduate entries, annualTuition is the year-1 figure (2 semesters) instead of the 2-year average, and year 2 is carried as laterYears on the current record and on the 2024-2026 history rows (same page, same table). Totals are unchanged.

programmes.name: Graduate School of Asia Pacific Studies, Master's in Asia Pacific Studies
programmes.summary: Before scholarships, 2027 entrants pay ¥1,455,000 in year 1 and ¥1,655,000 in year 2 (¥3,110,000 for the 2-year Master's in Asia Pacific Studies), plus a one-off ¥200,000 admission fee. Taught in English.
programmes.notes: Graduate Tuition and Fees page (from AY2027): Master's in Asia Pacific Studies total tuition ¥3,110,000 for completion, divided by a 2-year standard duration = ¥1,555,000/yr. Admission fee ¥200,000. Insurance ¥6,850 excluded. Fields include International Relations, Society and Culture, Development Economics, International Public Administration, Sustainability Science, Tourism and Hospitality. Fully English-based. History rows (read 2026-10-13): APU 'Tuition fees (Graduate School)' page, table for students enrolled in AY 2020 - AY 2026: 2-year standard course semesters ¥650,000, ¥650,000, ¥750,000, ¥750,000, total ¥2,800,000, divided by 2 years = ¥1,400,000/yr; admission fee ¥200,000. Second look 2026-10-14: the summary quoted a fixed programme total but cohortLocked was false, so the site grew year 2 by the yearly increase. APU's graduate fee page (https://en.apu.ac.jp/home/life/content32/, read 2026-10-14) publishes one semester-by-semester schedule per entering cohort ('Students enrolled in AY2027': Master's in Asia Pacific Studies semesters 1-2 ¥727,500 each and 3-4 ¥827,500 each, total ¥3,110,000; 'Students enrolled in AY2020 and AY2026 earlier': ¥650,000 x 2 then ¥750,000 x 2, total ¥2,800,000), so cohortLocked is now true as for the undergraduate entries, annualTuition is the year-1 figure (2 semesters) instead of the 2-year average, and year 2 is carried as laterYears on the current record and on the 2024-2026 history rows (same page, same table).
